'''''Star Wars: Darth Vader'''''<ref name="DH">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19481&p=260591|thread=Star Wars Series Update Request|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2012-07-18|time=12:47}}</ref> is the umbrella name for a series of five-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] that focus on the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The first two miniseries, [[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Lost Command|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'']] and [[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'']], were written by [[W. Haden Blackman]], while the two most recent series, [[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin|''Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin'']] and [[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows|''Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows'']], are written by [[Tim Siedell]]. Each miniseries has featured different pencillers, colorists, inkers, and cover artists, and they have each been released in hardcover collections. All four series take place shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
